slides.slide_title: Dataset foundations and explainable stereotype detection

claims.claim: Indian Institute of Information Technology Kottayam
Dataset foundations and explainable stereotype detection
Definition-aligned benchmark for stereotypes, anti-stereotypes, neutrality, and bias. Provides the five-class labels used in this project. [1]
Combines ALBERT-based stereotype detection with LIME/SHAP explanations. Motivates diagnostic word attribution for our five-class setting. [2]
The HEARTS binary task and StereoDetect five-class task use different evaluation settings.

slides.slide_title: Task adaptation improves all three task setups

claims.claim: Indian Institute of Information Technology Kottayam
Task adaptation improves all three task setups
• Sentence-only label: 93.84% accuracy • Conditioned label: 95.51% accuracy • JSON label: 93.61% accuracy • All three JSON fields: 92.87% Color maps show signed word influence.

• Review class 0 / class 1 errors • Match runtimes, precision and seeds • Evaluate calibration and new domains • Extend explanation diagnostics Explanations describe the model; they do not prove label correctness.
